props.heading: Born from the soil, built for the future
props.text: We are a team of agronomists, engineers and nature lovers on a mission to make every farm in India a self-sustaining ecosystem.

props.heading: Our vision
props.body: A self-sustaining farm on every piece of land: the land feeds the farmer, the farmer nurtures the land, and together they create abundance that lasts generations.

props.heading: Our mission
props.body: To combine satellite technology, permaculture science and hands-on execution to turn any piece of land into a thriving, productive, self-sustaining farm. We handle everything from design to management.

items.title: Nature first
items.text: Every decision starts with what is best for the ecosystem. Zero chemicals, always.

items.title: Radical transparency
items.text: Every visit documented, every rupee accounted for, every decision explained.

items.title: Science over guesswork
items.text: Satellite data, contour maps and soil analysis: we design with data.

items.title: Complete ownership
items.text: We execute, manage and take full responsibility for your farm.

items.title: Community impact
items.text: Local employment, skills for rural youth and degraded land restored.

items.title: Long-term thinking
items.text: We design for decades: every farm is a 30-year asset.

props.heading: Farm design
props.text: Satellite imagery, NDVI analysis and contour maps turn into a complete layout: every swale, bund, tree row and planting zone placed along the natural contour.

items.title: NDVI vegetation analysis
items.text: Colour-coded maps of plant health, bare spots and biological activity.

items.title: Elevation and slope mapping
items.text: Topographic data down to 30 cm changes in elevation.

items.title: Keyline design
items.text: Swales and bunds on the keylines to hold the most moisture.

items.title: Zonal planting plan
items.text: Fruit, timber, spice and forest zones placed by sun, wind and water access.

seo.title: Farm design | Hasiru Agro Farm Development
seo.description: Satellite imagery, NDVI analysis and contour maps turn into a complete layout: every swale, bund, tree row and planting zone placed along the natural contour.

props.heading: Earthwork and land preparation
props.text: Swales to harvest rainwater, basins for moisture, ponds for the microclimate and terraces for slopes. Every cubic foot of earth moved has an ecological purpose.

items.title: Bio-swales and basins
items.text: Structures that slow, sink and spread water across the contour lines.

items.title: Ponds
items.text: Water storage that also cools the microclimate.

items.title: Boundary and wind breaks
items.text: Tabebuia, Pongamia, bamboo and mahogany as natural boundaries.

seo.title: Earthwork and land preparation | Hasiru Agro Farm Development
seo.description: Swales to harvest rainwater, basins for moisture, ponds for the microclimate and terraces for slopes.

props.heading: Planting
props.text: Multi-layer planting from our own nursery: boundary trees, green manure, quick-yield crops, fruit trees and timber, each in the right zone.

items.title: Boundary plantation
items.text: Tabebuia, Pongamia, wild badam, bamboo and mahogany for wind breaks and privacy.

items.title: Green manure
items.text: Sesbania, Gliricidia, Moringa, Vetiver and Lemongrass for organic matter.

items.title: Short-term yield
items.text: Lemon, banana, papaya, pineapple and mulberry for early returns.

items.title: Fruiting plants
items.text: Jackfruit, avocado, litchi, orange and musambi.

items.title: Timber trees
items.text: Mahogany, sandalwood, red sandal and rosewood as a long-term asset.

seo.title: Planting | Hasiru Agro Farm Development

props.heading: Site assessment
props.text: Our agronomists walk your land and study soil texture, water sources, slope and microclimate. Everything else is built on this.

items.title: Soil analysis
items.text: Samples from several points for pH, organic matter, nutrients and microbial activity.

items.title: Water source mapping
items.text: Borewells, springs, seasonal streams and the rainfall pattern.

items.title: Microclimate study
items.text: Sun exposure, wind, frost pockets and shade across the seasons.

seo.title: Site assessment | Hasiru Agro Farm Development
seo.description: Our agronomists walk your land and study soil texture, water sources, slope and microclimate.

props.heading: Water management
props.text: Rainwater is slowed, sunk and spread across the land, so the farm handles both drought and heavy rain by design.

items.title: Bio-swales
items.text: Rainwater harvesting structures along the contour lines.

items.title: Basins
items.text: Hold moisture at the root zone of each plant.

items.title: Drip irrigation
items.text: Water delivered by zone, with nothing wasted.

items.title: Fertigation setup
items.text: Drum, venturi and shade structure for mixing nutrients into the drip.

testimonials.author: Rajesh M
testimonials.body: A very well maintained nursery with knowledgeable staff. I got fruit plants from here and they're all growing really well in our farm. Planning to visit again. Keep up the good work!

testimonials.author: Sornah Pandian
testimonials.body: This beautiful farm has a whole range of saplings, all naturally grown with a lustrous, healthy look. I'd recommend anyone to visit, enjoy the green view, and let them give you a tour with detailed explanations about each plant.

testimonials.author: Yash Shah
testimonials.body: Before visiting Hasiru Agro, I thought I knew farming. There is so much to learn. I found new and effective techniques that yield better results. Amazing quality saplings and really sweet people!
